text: The paper gives a "computer assisted proof of the full listing of central configuration ... for n = 5, 6, 7 with equal masses". On n=8: "For this reason we were not able to obtain a rigorous listing of CCs for n = 8". The reason is exponential scaling: n=5 took 24 s, n=6 about 1 h, n=7 almost 100 h.
